<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD contains only standard AUR package metadata and conventional build steps. The top-level scope consists of variable definitions (e.g., _gitauthor, _gitname, pkgver, source paths) and three functions (verify, build, package). None of these execute during `makepkg --printsrcinfo` — that command only parses the PKGBUILD file without running any of the functions. The verify() function performs read-only checksum validation using standard tools (sed, sha256sum), the build() function creates shell completion scripts, and the package() function installs the binary and completion files. There are no command substitutions, untrusted downloads, obfuscated code, or any other potentially dangerous operations in the top-level scope. The source URLs point to the official GitHub repository (atago) and the checksums are standard SHA-256 values. All operations are confined to the package's own directory and do not interact with external systems or execute arbitrary code.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
<summary>The PKGBUILD is a standard AUR package with only safe variable definitions and read-only verification; no malicious code or dangerous operations exist in the top-level scope.</summary>
